title: Bambu Studio slicer adapter config
description: Configuration for Bambu Studio desktop slicer. CLI slicing not available; detection is filesystem-only.

exe_path.description: Absolute path to bambu-studio.exe or equivalent launcher.

version.description: Version string if available from file metadata or installer records.

cli_supported.description: False — BambuStudio does not expose a stable headless CLI version command.

metadata_only.description: When true, verification uses filesystem metadata only (no launch).

launch_mode.description: Always 'desktop_app'; never launched headlessly by Hermes3D.
